svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.20.6.4 Masonry Veneer
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.20 MASONRY AND INSULATING CONCRETE FORM WALLS NOT IN CONTACT WITH THE GROUND

g.text: Solid masonry units not less than 75 mm
Over wood framing: air space not less
Veneer less than 90 mm thick: unraked
Raked joints in veneer less than 90 mm
Not covered by the 75 mm solid unit

svg.text: Except where each masonry unit is supported
masonry veneer consists of solid masonry units
wood-frame walls has not less than a 25 mm
Masonry veneer less than 90 mm (3 9/16″) thick
where the units are required to be
Drawn: ties, sheathing membrane and flashing not shown. Air space tinted blue. C supports are schematic, not a design.
